Name: Purchasable Galaxy Item
Author: SorryLate
Description:
[b]Purchasable Galaxy Item
[/b]By default you can buy Galaxy Weapon after get Galaxy Sword in Desert. But with this mod after you reach bottom of mine, Marlon will sell Galaxy Sword, Galaxy Dagger and Galaxy Hammer. So be ready for your next journey!

[b]Note :
[/b]Actually i was add Galaxy Slingshot to this mod, but i don't know why when i buy that Slingshot become normal Slingshot. So, if i found a fix i will add Galaxy Slingshot to this mod again.
